c.question: Tell me about a time you used data to change a product decision.
c.answer: At Acme Cloud our self-serve activation was stuck around 31%. I pulled funnel data in Amplitude and saw 40% of users dropped at step three of the setup wizard, where we asked for a data source connection before showing any value. I proposed moving the connection step after a sample-data preview, got buy-in from our designer and engineering lead by showing the drop-off chart, and we ran an A/B test for three weeks. The variant lifted activation from 31% to 44%, which the growth team estimated was worth roughly an extra 600 activated accounts a quarter. I then rolled it out and documented the test so we reused the pattern on two other flows.

evaluation.improved_answer: At Acme Cloud I owned the launch of our new enterprise tier. I started by analyzing market demand and defining the product requirements, then worked with a designer and a cross‑functional team of 25 engineers to build the feature end‑to‑end. I set up the rollout plan, coordinated the go‑to‑market strategy, and monitored early adoption using our analytics tools. Within a year the new tier drove revenue from $2 million to $40 million, far exceeding our growth targets. The launch also opened a new segment of high‑value customers and positioned the company for sustained expansion.
